Container.Name: Obsidian-Live-Sync-Cli
Container.Overview: Headless Self-hosted LiveSync client that continuously synchronizes a local Obsidian vault with CouchDB without running Obsidian.
Container.PostArgs:
-c ' run_uid="${PUID:-99}" run_gid="${PGID:-100}" settings_file="/data/.livesync/settings.json" bootstrap_pending="/data/.livesync/unraid-bootstrap-pending" bootstrap_complete="/data/.livesync/unraid-bootstrap-v1"
run_as_user() { setpriv --reuid="$run_uid" --regid="$run_gid" --clear-groups "$@" }
idle_forever() { exec setpriv --reuid="$run_uid" --regid="$run_gid" --clear-groups /bin/sh -c "trap exit TERM INT; while :; do sleep 3600 & wait \$!; done" }
is_true() { case "${1:-}" in 1|true|TRUE|yes|YES|on|ON) return 0 ;; *) return 1 ;; esac }
is_configured() { [ -s "$settings_file" ] && grep -Eq "\"isConfigured\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true" "$settings_file" }
normalise_settings() { run_as_user node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\"); const p=\"/data/.livesync/settings.json\"; try { const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,\"utf8\")); let changed=false; const raw=process.env.LOCAL_DATABASE_SUFFIX || \"unraid-cli\"; const suffix=raw.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/g,\"\") || \"unraid-cli\"; if (s.additionalSuffixOfDatabaseName !== suffix) { s.additionalSuffixOfDatabaseName=suffix; changed=true; console.log(\"[Bootstrap] Local database suffix: \" + suffix); } const enableLive=!/^(0|false|no|off)$/i.test(process.env.ENABLE_LIVE_SYNC || \"true\"); if (enableLive && (s.liveSync !== true || s.syncOnStart !== true || s.syncOnSave !== true)) { s.liveSync=true; s.syncOnStart=true; s.syncOnSave=true; changed=true; console.log(\"[Bootstrap] Continuous and save-triggered replication enabled\"); } if (changed) { const t=p+\".tmp\"; fs.writeFileSync(t,JSON.stringify(s,null,2)); fs.renameSync(t,p); } } catch (e) { console.error(\"[Bootstrap] Could not prepare CLI settings: \" + e.message); process.exit(1); }" }
umask "${UMASK:-002}" mkdir -p /data/.livesync chown "$run_uid:$run_gid" /data /data/.livesync if [ -f "$settings_file" ]; then chown "$run_uid:$run_gid" "$settings_file" fi
if ! run_as_user test -w /vault; then echo "[Bootstrap] The vault at /vault is not writable by PUID $run_uid and PGID $run_gid." echo "[Bootstrap] Correct the host-directory permissions, then restart this container." idle_forever fi
if ! is_configured; then if [ -z "${SETUP_URI:-}" ] || [ -z "${SETUP_PASSPHRASE:-}" ]; then echo "[Bootstrap] Waiting for first-time configuration." echo "[Bootstrap] Edit this container and fill in Setup URI and Setup URI Passphrase, then restart it." idle_forever fi
echo "[Bootstrap] Importing the supplied Setup URI..." if ! printf "%s\n" "$SETUP_PASSPHRASE" | run_as_user /usr/local/bin/livesync-cli setup "$SETUP_URI"; then echo "[Bootstrap] Setup URI import failed. Check the URI and passphrase in the template." idle_forever fi run_as_user touch "$bootstrap_pending" echo "[Bootstrap] Setup URI imported successfully." fi
if ! normalise_settings; then idle_forever fi
if [ -f "$bootstrap_pending" ] && is_true "${AUTO_INITIAL_SYNC:-true}"; then first_vault_entry=$(find /vault -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit 2>/dev/null) if [ -n "$first_vault_entry" ]; then echo "[Bootstrap] Automatic initial sync stopped because /vault is not empty: $first_vault_entry" echo "[Bootstrap] Use an empty destination vault, or disable Automatic Initial Sync and manage the merge manually." idle_forever fi
echo "[Bootstrap] Authorising this new CLI device on the existing remote..." if ! run_as_user /usr/local/bin/livesync-cli mark-resolved; then echo "[Bootstrap] The CLI device could not be authorised. Verify CouchDB connectivity and restart to retry." idle_forever fi
echo "[Bootstrap] Pulling the existing remote database before the vault scanner starts..." if ! run_as_user /usr/local/bin/livesync-cli sync; then echo "[Bootstrap] Initial CouchDB pull failed. The bootstrap remains pending and will retry after restart." idle_forever fi
run_as_user mv -f "$bootstrap_pending" "$bootstrap_complete" echo "[Bootstrap] Initial remote sync completed." fi
set -- --vault /vault case "${LOG_MODE:-normal}" in verbose) set -- "$@" --verbose ;; debug) set -- "$@" --debug ;; esac if [ -n "${SYNC_INTERVAL:-}" ]; then set -- "$@" --interval "$SYNC_INTERVAL" fi
echo "[Bootstrap] Starting the LiveSync daemon." stop_requested=0 child_pid="" stop_daemon() { stop_requested=1 if [ -n "$child_pid" ]; then kill -TERM "$child_pid" 2>/dev/null || true fi } trap stop_daemon TERM INT run_as_user /usr/local/bin/livesync-cli "$@" daemon & child_pid=$! wait "$child_pid" daemon_status=$? if [ "$stop_requested" -eq 1 ]; then exit "$daemon_status" fi
echo "[Recovery] LiveSync daemon exited with status $daemon_status." echo "[Recovery] The container will remain running so its console and logs stay available." idle_forever '
Container.Description:
Obsidian LiveSync CLI is the official headless command-line client for Self-hosted LiveSync. It mirrors a local Markdown vault to the same CouchDB database used by the Obsidian plug-in.
CLICK-AND-GO FIRST BOOT: 1. On a working Obsidian device, generate a new Self-hosted LiveSync Setup URI and its passphrase. 2. Map Obsidian Vault to a new, empty destination directory. Keep Database / Config separate from it. 3. Paste the Setup URI and passphrase into the masked template fields, then start the container. 4. The bootstrap imports the settings, fixes device-specific paths, enables live replication, authorises only this new CLI node, pulls the existing CouchDB database, and starts the daemon. No console commands or restart are required. 5. After the log reports Initial remote sync completed, clear the Setup URI and passphrase fields from the container definition. The imported settings remain under /data.
Existing configured installations skip the bootstrap automatically; leave both Setup fields empty. Automatic Initial Sync runs only for settings imported by this template and refuses to continue unless /vault is empty. It never rebuilds or deletes the remote database.
PATHS: - Database / Config stores the CLI's private local database and settings. It is not the Obsidian vault. - Obsidian Vault is the directory containing the Markdown files to synchronize. - Keep these mappings separate. Never map /data and /vault to the same host directory.
OPERATION: - No ports or WebUI are required for CouchDB synchronization. - The CouchDB address embedded in the Setup URI must be reachable from this container. An address using localhost refers to the CLI container itself, not the Unraid host or another CouchDB container. - The default mode follows CouchDB's live changes feed. Set Sync Interval only when periodic polling is preferred or a reverse proxy cannot keep the changes feed open. - The configured PUID and PGID must have read/write access to the mapped vault. The startup wrapper only adjusts ownership of the dedicated /data directory; it never changes vault ownership. - Local Database Suffix replaces device-specific paths imported from another device. Keep it limited to letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens. - Enable Live Synchronization forces liveSync, syncOnStart, and syncOnSave on for this dedicated CLI client. Disable it only when intentionally inheriting those switches from the Setup URI. - Setup URI and passphrase are masked in the Unraid form but are still Docker environment variables. Clear both fields after successful bootstrap. - Back up the vault before first use, and do not run another file-sync tool against the same server-side vault directory.
Container.Changes:
###v1.1.0 (2026-09-21) - Adds click-and-go bootstrap using masked Setup URI and passphrase fields. - Safely onboards only a new empty vault: import, normalise, authorise this node, pull the remote, then start live replication. - Persists a pending bootstrap marker so interrupted first runs retry without manual commands. - Existing configured installations remain untouched and skip first-run onboarding.
###v1.0.0 (2026-09-21) - Initial Unraid template release. - Runs the official LiveSync CLI image as a continuous CouchDB-to-vault daemon. - Adds an idle first-run state with interactive Setup URI initialization. - Supports Unraid PUID, PGID, umask, polling interval, and verbose logging options. - Normalizes imported device-local database suffixes so Android vault paths cannot become invalid container paths. - Documents the targeted mark-resolved recovery for a new CLI client joining a locked, rebuilt remote. - Keeps the container running after a daemon failure so recovery commands can be entered through the Unraid console. - Enables continuous and save-triggered CouchDB replication by default, independent of the source device's Setup URI switches.

Config.Name: Database / Config
Config.Description: Dedicated persistent directory for the CLI's local database and .livesync/settings.json. Do not map this to the vault.

Config.Name: Obsidian Vault
Config.Description: Host directory containing the Markdown vault to synchronize. PUID and PGID must have read/write access.

Config.Name: Setup URI (first boot only)
Config.Description: Paste the Setup URI generated by a working Self-hosted LiveSync device. Leave empty on an existing configured installation, and clear it after successful bootstrap.

Config.Name: Setup URI Passphrase (first boot only)
Config.Description: Passphrase created with the Setup URI. Leave empty on an existing configured installation, and clear it after successful bootstrap.

Config.Name: Process User ID
Config.Description: User ID used for LiveSync database and vault file access. Unraid's standard nobody user is 99.

Config.Name: Process Group ID
Config.Description: Group ID used for LiveSync database and vault file access. Unraid's standard users group is 100.

Config.Name: File Creation Mask
Config.Description: Unix umask applied to files created by the CLI. 002 keeps files writable by the configured group.

Config.Name: Local Database Suffix
Config.Description: Safe device-local name for the CLI database. This replaces Android or desktop vault paths imported through a Setup URI.

Config.Name: Enable Live Synchronization
Config.Description: Force continuous replication, startup replication, and replication after a local save for this CLI client.

Config.Name: Automatic Initial Sync
Config.Description: After this template imports new settings, require an empty vault, authorise this CLI node, and pull CouchDB before starting the daemon. Keep enabled for click-and-go setup.

Config.Name: Sync Interval
Config.Description: Optional polling interval in seconds. Leave empty for the near-real-time CouchDB changes feed.

Config.Name: Log Mode
Config.Description: Logging detail: normal, verbose, or debug. Debug output can contain sensitive server details.
